column1: # Files in lib/kdb-fix-adaptor whose bytes differ from upstream 11941454f022 (#2448).
# REVIEWED AND ACCEPTED as patches: the tree as upstream ships it does not
# configure or compile, and these edits are the least that makes it build
# against current QuickFIX (master, C++17) and CMake 4, on macOS as well as
# Linux. Every edit, and why, is in lib/kdb-fix-adaptor/NOTICE.md. kind
# "edit": a change to content, not whitespace.
#   CMakeLists.txt  cmake_minimum_required 3.2 -> 3.10 (CMake 4 refuses
#                   < 3.5, warns < 3.10); configure_file reads
#                   LICENSE-kdb-fix-adaptor, the name this tree gives
#                   upstream's LICENSE.md; -std=c++11 -> -std=c++17 (QuickFIX
#                   master needs it); -Wno-deprecated-declarations (macOS's
#                   SDK deprecates sprintf, used by bundled pugixml, and
#                   -Werror made that fatal); on APPLE, link with
#                   -undefined dynamic_lookup (the k.h symbols come from q).
#   src/main.cxx    throw(...) specifications -> QuickFIX's EXCEPT(...),
#                   as its Application interface declares them (C++17 has no
#                   dynamic exception specifications); high_resolution_clock
#                   -> system_clock for a wall-clock time (on libc++ the
#                   former is steady_clock, which has no to_time_t).
# To revert to upstream: python3 scripts/dev/revendor.py kdb-fix-adaptor
# (which deletes this file, and the build breaks again). The gate fails if any
# listed file changes again; a further patch changes this file, its
# drift_digest in lib/VENDORED.toml and NOTICE.md together.
# path
CMakeLists.txt
src/main.cxx
